families.reference: m=(ids>=vs)&(ids<ve); out = torch.where(m[:,None], F.embedding((ids-vs).clamp(0, ve-vs-1), weight), 0)
families.notes: TP vocab shard; out-of-shard ids give zero rows (summed later by all-reduce). Assumes weight last-dim contiguous.

families.reference: text rows (vs<=id<ve): out[s]=wte[id-vs]*text_embed_scale; image i rows (st[i]<=id<st[i]+len[i]): out[s]=embed_cache[loc[i]+id-st[i],0,:]/tp_world_size; other rows untouched. mark: out_mark[i]=int(((ids>=st[i])&(ids<st[i]+len[i])).any())
families.notes: Caller pre-zeroes out and all-reduces over TP; image placeholder ids live above the text vocab. Overlapping text/image id ranges would race.

families.reference: e=embed if embed.dim()==3 else embed[:,None]; cache[s:s+T,:e.shape[1]]=e; cache[s:s+T,e.shape[1]:]=0
families.notes: Cache is [token, layer(<=4), H] (Qwen3-VL deepstack); layers beyond the source are zero-filled on purpose.

families.reference: offload: for page p with page_idx[p]!=-1 and not ready[p]: cpu[page_idx[p], l, t, cpu_heads] = gpu[l, tok_idx[p*TB+t], gpu_heads] (head lists from wrapper's TP mapping; same for scales); load is the inverse gather/scatter; hybrid/linear-att variants are byte-wise copies of conv/ssm state rows into cpu pages
families.notes: Writes/reads pinned host memory via UVA. Expected output fully fixed by wrapper code, but the TP head mapping (K/V halves, only tp_index%scale==0 writes) is a library layout to replicate. Kernel uses first head index + count, i.e. assumes contiguous head ranges.

families.reference: kv_move: buf[:, dst] = buf[:, src]; mamba copy: dst[:, dst_idx] = src[:, src_idx]; fork: dst[:, dst_idx] = src[:, src_idx.repeat_interleave(num_dst_per_src)]; tensor_copy_3dim: dest.copy_(src)
families.notes: In-place same-buffer copy (kv_move) is order-dependent if src/dst sets overlap; reference assumes disjoint. Byte-level (uint8 view) copies.

families.reference: kv_trans: output[output_idx] = input[input_idx]; v2: same with input/output buffer chosen per token from a uint64 pointer table indexed by dp_idx; page_io write: page_k[t, l, head_start+h] = k[l, mem_index[t], h] (read = inverse); mla_page_io analogous on kv_buffer
families.notes: PD-disaggregation transfer; v2 for_p_node passes output strides as input strides (assumes identical layout across DP mem managers). Raw pointer tables need same-device buffers.

families.reference: Per docstrings: verify accept_len[r] = 1 + first i where R[req, i+1] != new_ids[start+i] (greedy exact match, capped at row count), accepted_index = arange < accept_len; group markers write run size (split by MAX_GROUP_SIZE) at each group's last row, hold rows = 1; gen_mtp_new_input_ids shifts each request's ids left by one and appends next token; compaction = stable boolean-mask select (cumsum dst positions); cumprod_scores = cumprod(clamp(scores[1:],0.01,0.99) with scores[0]=1)
families.notes: Deterministic MTP/speculative bookkeeping with docstring-specified examples. Single-program kernels with BLOCK=next_pow2(batch) (large batches -> big blocks). mtp_scatter fills unused draft columns with token id 1.

families.reference: b1_cu = F.pad(cumsum(len),(1,0)).int(); position_ids = cat([arange(ready[b], seq[b])]); sampling params = req_to_X[b_req_idx] for the 5 params; same_req_mark[i] = count of rows with b_req_idx==b_req_idx[i] at the last such row else 0 (hold_req rows -> 1)
families.notes: cumsum carry uses tl.max of the running cumsum (correct only for non-negative lengths).

families.notes: No docstring for ks/ke; req_to_token stride(1) ignored (assumes contiguous).

families.reference: counter += torch.bincount(ids[ids<V], minlength=V); update: C.index_put_((b_req_idx, next_ids), ones, accumulate=True) (masked rows skipped); expert: counter += bincount(topk_ids.flatten(), minlength=E)
families.notes: Atomic integer adds; order-independent.

open_decisions: physical expert id layout: per rank ep_expert_num regular + redundancy_expert_num redundant slots
tokens routed to a redundant logical expert always go to the local rank's replica
optional counter counts logical ids before remap
families.notes: In-place on topk_ids; remap formula reproduced in the unit test.

families.reference: scatter: T[b_req_idx, b_mtp_index] = ids (where has_out); gather: T[b_req_idx, b_mtp_index]; mixed: input_ids[start_loc[m]] = T[req[m], mtp[m]] for decode rows; logprobs: buf[mem_idx, :k] = (ids, logprobs) for 0<=mem_idx<kv_size; routing: buf[mem_idx, layer*topk:(layer+1)*topk] = topk_ids.to(uint8|int16)
families.notes: Targets are pinned CPU tensors / raw uint64 device-visible host pointers. scatter/gather ignore stride(1) (assume contiguous last dim). routing narrows ids to uint8/int16 (wraps if E>256/32767).

families.reference: local_logits.t().contiguous()
families.notes: Only used for contiguous bf16 [V,B] with B>=16; followed by torch.topk (tie order unspecified, not part of kernel).

families.reference: pack: torch.cat([values.float(), (token_ids+vocab_start).int().view(torch.float32)], 1); unpack: p=packed.view(W,T,2,K); values=p[:,:,0].permute(1,0,2).reshape(T,W*K); ids=p[:,:,1].contiguous().view(torch.int32).permute(1,0,2).reshape(T,W*K).long()
families.notes: Token ids are bit-cast into fp32 slots (not numerically converted).

families.reference: n=in.shape[0]; m=cdiv(n,W); out = in[torch.arange(rank*m,(rank+1)*m) % n]
families.notes: Likely bug: wrapper asserts n % W == 0 right before launch, so the padding kernel is unreachable and the unit test's non-divisible cases (n=3..5, W=2..4) would raise.
